meta.name: alterlab-anndata
meta.description: Build, slice, concatenate, read, and write AnnData annotated data matrices (obs, var, X, layers, obsm, uns) — the scverse data STRUCTURE, not an analysis pipeline. Use when creating or wrangling .h5ad/zarr files, managing cell and gene annotations, concatenating batches, or handling layers/obsm/backed-mode; for the QC, normalization, clustering, UMAP, and differential-expression analysis pipeline prefer alterlab-scanpy instead, and for RNA velocity from spliced/unspliced layers prefer alterlab-scvelo instead. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 构建和操作单细胞基因表达数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理.h5ad或zarr格式的单细胞数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Build and manipulate single-cell gene expression data matrices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with .h5ad or zarr single-cell data files

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、读取、写入、切片、拼接 AnnData 数据对象，管理细胞和基因注释，处理多层数据（obs、var、X、layers、obsm 等），但不做分析流程（如聚类、UMAP）。
howto.when: 当用户需要处理 .h5ad 或 .zarr 文件、管理单细胞或基因注释、拼接多个批次数据、或操作 AnnData 的层/多维注释时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 h5ad 文件，并显示 obs 和 var 的前几行。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并展示数据概览。

say.text: 将两个 AnnData 对象按观测轴拼接，并标记来源批次。
say.note: Claude 会执行 ad.concat 并添加批次标签。

say.text: 根据 obs 中的细胞类型筛选出 T 细胞子集。
say.note: Claude 会按条件过滤并返回子集。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, write, slice, concatenate AnnData objects, manage cell and gene annotations, and handle layers/obsm/uns, but does not perform analysis pipelines like clustering or UMAP.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to work with .h5ad or .zarr files, manage cell/gene annotations, concatenate batches, or manipulate AnnData layers/obsm/backed mode.

say_en.text: Read this h5ad file and show the first few rows of obs and var.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and display an overview.

say_en.text: Concatenate two AnnData objects along observations and label the source batches.
say_en.note: Claude will perform ad.concat with batch labels.

say_en.text: Filter the AnnData to keep only T cells based on cell_type in obs.
say_en.note: Claude will subset by condition and return the subset.
